Save a copy of the application to your computer. It works in a current desktop browser, including offline.

Download Klein Billing Check
  1. Open the downloaded HTML file in Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari.
  2. Choose Try example data to see a worked comparison.
  3. Download the three CSV templates and replace the example rows with your own complete billing-period data.
  4. Confirm the pricing assumptions, compare your files and export the findings.

If your browser opens the app instead of saving it, use its Save page option to keep the HTML file, or right-click the download button and choose Save link as.

If you completed checkout, your Stripe receipt is your proof of business licence. There is no activation code. The US$49 purchase covers internal use by one business. Evaluation before purchase is permitted.
